status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: UnswapIterator may be created concurrently from multiple threads. As a result, the partition may become evicted while the other thread is iterating. We need to handle InvalidPartitionException in iterator and stop iteration when this exception is encountered.
In the provided patch next() method does not call advance which creates infinite result set.

I think I already fixed this error (commit 8a4b7541): GridDhtInvalidPartitionException is handled in clearAll(), if this exception is thrown then partition is already cleared and we can stop iteration.
